TABLE.NAME: local_vrbcert_issued
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per issued certificate: unique on (userid, brandkey, period).

FIELD.NAME: brandkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Brand cohort idnumber (e.g. brand_veeba) for the per-brand track, or the literal 'overall' for the overall track.

FIELD.NAME: brandname
FIELD.COMMENT: Display snapshot of the brand/overall name at issue time.

FIELD.NAME: certrank
FIELD.COMMENT: Leaderboard position at issue time (from the API row, display only).

FIELD.NAME: scorepercent
FIELD.COMMENT: Score percent at issue time (from the API row, display only).

FIELD.NAME: strategykey
FIELD.COMMENT: Ranking strategy key in effect at issue time.

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Stored PDF filename in the local_vrbcert/certificate filearea (itemid = this row id).

FIELD.NAME: issuedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Admin user id who triggered issuance, or 0 for cron.
